summary: Suicidal woman on an 80-ft cliff on Red Stone Road (aka Piney Road), Vail; crews descended 400 ft to the canyon floor, crossed Red Sandstone Creek and climbed to contact her; a Vail Mountain Rescue member rappelled down to her, crews lowered her to the canyon bottom and helped her climb out over ~4 hrs in cold, icy, rockfall conditions
location: 80-ft cliff on Red Stone Road (Piney Road), Vail, above Red Sandstone Creek
responding_agency: Vail Mountain Rescue Group + Vail Fire Dept, Vail Police Dept, Eagle County Paramedic Services
notes: Resolved the run-244 pending VMRG lead.
